name: @aily-project/lib-chipintelli-sd
author: ChipIntelli Arduino contributors / ailyProject
description: 通过 CI13XX GPIO 软件 SPI 访问 FAT16/FAT32 SD 卡，支持自定义引脚、错误诊断及完整文件与目录操作。
description_zh_cn: 通过 CI13XX GPIO 软件 SPI 访问 FAT16/FAT32 SD 卡，支持自定义引脚、错误诊断及完整文件与目录操作。
description_en: Access FAT16/FAT32 SD cards through CI13XX GPIO software SPI with custom pins, diagnostics, and file and directory operations.
